<h2 class="section-title">India National Politics</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Political confrontations:</strong> Home Minister Amit Shah has likened the INDIA bloc’s mock Parliament to the &quot;Jantana Sarkar&quot; of Maoists, while Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman challenged Rahul Gandhi to debate government policies within Parliament rather than on social media.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I1</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I5</a> <a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMixgFBVV95cUxQbV9SQVE0Y2x1eFpvcjdvZXlmemhiSkM3eFVBdlJWNk1Jdlh1STJjRnhmVFZwWmQ3NGVjR2FuRUVhWkxmR1BhaTZ1SHNlb0NjYTd4akoyTGgtRzhYdS1lSDFNTndfbEI0QzJxb19CWEZsSWZON2lxeUZNbjhnSVVubDQ4Sk5HZlNCS3VKUDFMb1g2bnpWZUN5Qi1wT0gybkR5V2tHaFdvVU1BYWhadzFITm9xV3FWVXFYODZaZGUxRjMwSXlNZXc?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I7</a></span></li>

  <li><strong>Election integrity:</strong> The Election Commission of India reports that 134 million names were flagged for verification rather than deleted, amid ongoing public protests regarding voter list management.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMizAFBVV95cUxOSGVZVTZ3cl9sWUVESFZZMHJfQlV6ckJFUktsWTJRaFB2NFJtN3FDdE1DNVc1RERJXzJycFdJenkxcmVBQklTeHRjdUZlX0kxdnBmTEZvRURjNElHVDRPQUNGVGdhRWh4SERGSTVzbVdDSDdLMWRSdHVXSDg2N1kyb05VcVcwN3NYd1kzUDdSTUpicDNVV25PVnYxV1NaTE16UHVPd2FsNmpUMHctMGNieV9xOG1xMGJSSDhoZS1uNUVLV0ZNSklOOVpjcjg?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I2</a></span></li>
</ul>

<h2 class="section-title">Policy and Institutions</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Resource strategy:</strong> The Union government has introduced a new Rs 2,800-crore capital expenditure scheme aimed at securing and developing critical minerals to bolster national industrial capacity.</li>
  <li><strong>Corporate divestment:</strong> The proposed $5.5 billion sale of IDBI Bank to Fairfax is encountering significant resistance from both bank employees and political factions concerned over the privatization move.</li>
</ul>
